title: Feed mill scheduling task
description: One day of orders for one mill. A real mill's order book, feed catalog, carry-over rate and house rules convert into this format without code changes (SPEC section 13). Evaluate one with: python run.py --task-file path.json

task_id.description: Identifier of this task. Part of the task hash the log chain is anchored to.

seed.description: Generator seed. Absent for a task that did not come from the generator.

difficulty.description: easy, medium or hard for generated tasks; anything else for an external one.

horizon_min.description: Length of the production day in minutes. Minute 0 is 06:00.

carry_over_rate.description: Share of the previous batch that the next batch picks up.

flush_tonnes.description: Size of a flush batch. It is run through the line and discarded.

flush_minutes.description: How long a flush occupies the line.

die_change_minutes.description: Default die change duration. House rule H3 overrides it for one line.

max_steps.description: The episode truncates after this many actions.

feeds.description: The catalog this mill produces. Need not be the full example catalog.

species.description: Drives the intra-species ban L5 through the species-to-PAP mapping.

ruminant.description: true means the feed may never run on a line with pap_type other than none (L3).

carry_over_class.description: Coccidiostat sensitivity. sensitive is the 1 % limit, less_sensitive the 3 % limit, target the feed the substance belongs in.

lines.description: The production lines of the mill. Each keeps its own clock, die and residue.

pap_type.description: Which processed animal protein this line is dedicated to (L4, L5).

initial_concentrations.description: Residue left in the line before the day starts. Absent means clean.

orders.description: The day's order book. Every order must be produced exactly once, in full, before its due time.

due.description: Minutes after 06:00. The order must be finished at or before this.

house_rules.description: Company rules. They only ever tighten the law (SPEC section 5).

id.description: H1 customer_flush, H2 sequence_ban, H3 slow_die, H4 die_change_day_only, H5 lab_hold, H6 copper_sheep_flush.

text.description: The rule in one sentence, shown to the agent.
